comments.text: I have been following this case since it first hit national news. I can't imagine there are many women who did not see themselves in Sadé Robinson. At 19 years old and a young woman residing in NYC, I too, was dating as well as commencing my young adult Life. In those days, there were two instances in which I went to a man's "place" because I believed that was what one was supposed to do. I had seen so much Sex and the City and countless other shows and films that made it seem as though one need not give a second thought to entering someone's private Home. I am thankful I was never killed...but, surely, with just the right Sociopath masquerading as a normal, ostensibly charming person, I could have been. Any one of us, could have been her. 😞 That is what makes this case so excruciating. May Sadé rest in perfect Peace. Be safe everyone. 😢
